snippet.title: MSX Game: Double Dragon (1989 Zemina)
snippet.description:
A beat em' up game that started it all. Marion has been kidnapped by the black warriors and demanded the lee brothers to disclose their martial arts secrets in return for Marion's freedom. The Lee brothers retailiate by going on a mission to rescue and save Marion. They use whatever technique they have like basic punches, kicks, jump kicks, elbow strike, head butts, as well as weapons. that comes to their hands. The Lee brothers must pursue the gangs through city slums, industrial areas, and the forest reaching out to the black warriors hideout to confront big boss, Willy the gunman. 

Note: This one seems to be ported from the NES version. The controls seems sluggish here. The game was released only in Japan and Korea and it's another unlicensed game.
